target_customer: Researchers and clinicians needing background free fluorescence imaging and diagnostics
problem: Existing imaging methods could not detect tiny early tumors; nanodiamonds were claimed to give up to 100 times signal improvement.
business_model: Imaging probe and diagnostic technology licensed from NIH research

founders.name: Ambika Bumb
prior_employers: National Institutes of Health (two post-doctoral fellowships)
education: PhD, University of Oxford, Marshall Scholar
founders.background_notes: Education and NIH fellowships per her YC founder profile quoted at blog.ycombinator.com.

exit.reason: Founder said in a 2021 podcast that the IP returned to NIH and she chose to dissolve the company.

technical_complexity.rationale: Required nanomaterial production and regulated clinical validation for diagnostics.

defensibility.rationale: Licensed technology and IP from NIH, but not yet through clinical trials.

market_need_then: TechCrunch coverage cited in Wikipedia said current technologies cannot detect micrometastatic tumors, which Bikanta claimed to address.

brand_strength.rationale: No name origin, logo or community evidence found; science press covered the technology rather than the brand.

outcome_analysis: Bikanta had a credentialed scientist founder and early press but little capital. Wikipedia says that as it prepared for clinical trials the Theranos scandal made investors leave diagnostics and it could not raise the money. The founder later said the IP went back to NIH and the company was dissolved after about five and a half years.
notes: Funding conflict: CB Insights shows 20K on 2014-08-20 and a total of 20K; Wikipedia mirrors say 120K seed from 5 investors in 2014; SeedTable shows 1.7M. The 20K and 120K entries are probably not separate rounds. Wind-down details come from a single directory page quoting a podcast. Website is a Namecheap parking page. Competitor search found only later Adamas Nanotechnologies material, none dated near 2014, so the list is empty. tech_unsolved and macro_downturn are tentative.
